authorization: 老板：把没有重绘的资源全部重绘了吧
scope: 12 unrepainted active resource-card artworks; retain previously redrawn copper, one key and three keys; exclude retired starter-ration

items.name: keys-bunch
items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the item in image 1 as rough hand-painted anime game-resource art. Image 1 is the composition and object target. Images 2–4 are ONLY broad opaque brushwork references; never copy their people, costumes, props, words or watermark. Rebuild with distinctly fewer, larger connected opaque color masses, several wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, hard handmade shadow edges and selective broken stroke endings. Substantial quiet surfaces, readable main form and a few structural accents. Muted warm/cool material colors with concentrated highlights. No polished 3D, airbrush gloss, dense texture, thin scratch networks, all-over grain filters or microscopic ornament. Preserve the target's number of objects, pose, orientation and main proportions.

SUBJECT: Exactly two long metal keys cross in an X, with large faceted hexagonal champagne-gold heads near the upper left and upper right, a small silver linking ring between them, long cool-gray shafts extending to lower opposite corners and chunky dark teeth near the bottoms. Keep the two-key count, crossings, long proportions and original three-quarter view. Simplify head bevels and metal reflection into a few large painted planes.

Square canvas. Center the complete item with clear margins; object group fills roughly 70–75 percent of the canvas. Actual transparent alpha everywhere outside the object, including gaps between parts. No painted backing swatch, environment, black/white backdrop, drawn checkerboard, floor shadow, glow, particles or extra objects. No letters, numbers, text, card frame, border, watermark or UI.
